run_token_reward_online: run the vLLM token reward online example to test pooling API with a reward model
test_pooling_completions: test the pooling API with completions-style input containing a model and text prompt
test_pooling_chat: test the pooling API with chat-style input containing model and message array
build_cli_args: build an argparse CLI with configurable host and port for the token reward online script
post_http_request: post an HTTP request to the vLLM pooling endpoint with a JSON prompt payload
